slides.title: It's November... landscapers, you know what that means.
slides.body: the mowers are done. the paperwork is not.

slides.label: two
slides.title: Is the plow truck's registration current?
slides.body: Find out in the driveway, not on the side of the road during the first storm.

slides.label: three
slides.title: Snow clients want your COI.
slides.body: Property managers often ask before the season starts. Make sure the dates on it cover the winter.

slides.label: four
slides.title: Plowing isn't mowing.
slides.body: Ask your agent whether your policy covers snow and ice work before you take the contracts.

slides.label: five
slides.title: Licenses that renew over winter.
slides.body: Business license, applicator license, whatever yours is. Check the date while it's quiet.

slides.label: save this
slides.title: It's time. (to check the renewal dates.)
slides.body: Save it for the first snow forecast. Which one did you forget last year?
